title: Sketch curve
summary:
The users can sketch a curve (red line). The resulting point cloud is converted by the Visvalingam algorithm to a list consisting of a start point and an end point, as well as 6 internal points. Finally, these 8 points are interpolated by a cardinal spline curve.

Starting with version 1.13.0, the internal elements 'board.sketches[]' are used.
